summary: Join our team as a Junior Java Developer and learn from experienced engineers in a fast-paced payments technology environment.
responsibilities: Writing clean, testable Java code using Test-Driven Development (TDD) practices
Working collaboratively in cross-functional Agile/XP teams with pair programming sessions
Building and maintaining microservices that process thousands of payment transactions reliably and securely

Solid understanding of unit testing and integration testing using JUnit, Mockito
Test-Driven Development (TDD) methodology - ability to write tests before implementation
Familiarity with Spring Framework (Spring Boot, Spring MVC)
Understanding of relational databases (PostgreSQL, MySQL) and basic SQL
nice_to_have_skills: Exposure to AI-assisted coding tools (GitHub Copilot, Cursor, JetBrains AI + IntelliJ)
